name: AQRAB
premise: A fictional next-generation military mobility vehicle from the year 2100, shown as a cinematic 3D website: a night-street reveal controlled by scroll, an explorable command-centre interior and a defence-technology brand story. Replaces the earlier hypercar concept; do not use the green hypercar images.
look: cinematic science-fiction film still, anamorphic 35mm look, deep true blacks, restrained practical lighting, cool haze, thin cyan-green accent light
palette: void black, gunmetal, cold sodium amber, ultraviolet cyan-green
vehicle: a fictional armoured all-terrain vehicle from the year 2100: a low, very wide four-wheeled body built from overlapping faceted armour plates like a scorpion's exoskeleton, two armoured sensor pods reaching forward at the front like pincers, a narrow wraparound slit of armoured glass for the cabin, large airless honeycomb tyres on long-travel suspension, and a segmented sensor mast that arches forward over the roof like a scorpion's tail, ending in a compact sensor pod. The body is finished in an ultra-matte, light-absorbing black, so its shape shows only through faint edge reflections and thin lines of cyan-green light that trace the armour segments, like a scorpion glowing under ultraviolet light. Original design, no badges, no visible guns

shots.title: The empty street
shots.camera: Road level, centred vanishing point, 35mm anamorphic
shots.prompt: Cinematic night photograph of a deserted city street, camera low at road level looking straight down the middle of the road to a central vanishing point: wet black asphalt with long reflections, glass and concrete buildings with every window dark, one sodium streetlight pooling amber light, a traffic signal blinking amber in the distance, a thin layer of mist above the road, no cars, no people, quiet and tense. No vehicle in the frame.

shots.title: Something in the dark
shots.prompt: Cinematic night photograph of a deserted city street seen from road level down the middle of the road, wet asphalt, dark buildings, one sodium streetlight, mist. Far away in the darkness at the vanishing point, {vehicle} is approaching: almost invisible, only a few thin cyan-green light lines and a faint reflection on the wet road give it away. Most of the frame is empty street.

shots.title: The silhouette
shots.prompt: Cinematic night photograph of a deserted city street from road level, wet asphalt, dark buildings, mist, one sodium streetlight. {vehicle} is coming toward the camera at mid-distance: its black body is still barely readable, its silhouette outlined by the streetlight on its upper edges, the cyan-green segment lines brighter, the wet road reflecting them.

shots.title: The reveal
shots.section: Final sequence: last frame and hero
shots.prompt: Cinematic night photograph, camera very low on the wet street, {vehicle} has stopped a few metres from the camera, head-on: the faceted armoured nose, the two forward sensor pods, two narrow cold-white headlamp slits and the cyan-green segment lines glowing, mist drifting through the light, the sensor mast arching over the roof against the dark buildings. Imposing, precise, silent.

shots.title: Approach storyboard
shots.camera: Same street, same lens, four moments of one drone shot
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four frames from one continuous cinematic drone shot on the same deserted city street at night, identical street, light and weather in all four. Top-left: the empty street, the vehicle invisible in the dark far away, only faint cyan-green lines. Top-right: {vehicle} at mid-distance, silhouette starting to show. Bottom-left: the vehicle close, filling half the frame, lights glowing. Bottom-right: the drone rising as the vehicle passes beneath it, seen from above. Thin dark gutters between frames.

shots.title: Studio, three-quarter front
shots.camera: Low three-quarter front, 50mm, black void studio
shots.prompt: Studio photograph of {vehicle}, three-quarter front view in a pitch-black void studio, revealed only by one sweeping rim light that draws its outline and the edges of the armour plates, the cyan-green segment lines glowing softly, a faint reflection on a black glossy floor. Most of the body stays black.

shots.title: Studio, side profile
shots.prompt: Clean side-profile studio photograph of {vehicle}, perfectly parallel to the camera on a dark graphite seamless background, a soft top light and a thin rim light so the whole silhouette, wheelbase, suspension and the arched sensor mast are readable, no perspective distortion.

shots.title: Studio, rear three-quarter
shots.prompt: Studio photograph of {vehicle} from a high rear three-quarter angle, showing the segmented armour along its back and the sensor mast arching forward over the roof like a scorpion's tail, rim light tracing each segment, black void background.

shots.title: Desert crossing
shots.prompt: Cinematic photograph of {vehicle} crossing high sand dunes at first light, a long plume of dust behind it, low sun skimming the dune ridges, the black body absorbing the light so it reads as a moving silhouette, vast empty desert.

shots.title: Mountain storm
shots.prompt: Cinematic night photograph of {vehicle} climbing a mountain pass in a snowstorm, snow streaking through the cold-white headlamp beams and the cyan-green segment lines, ice on the armour edges, dark rock walls, harsh and lonely.

shots.title: Through water
shots.prompt: Cinematic night photograph of {vehicle} driving through a flooded concrete underpass in heavy rain, a bow wave of water rising from the airless tyres, sodium lights reflecting in the water, rain streaks, the black body glistening only at its edges.

shots.title: From above
shots.prompt: Top-down drone photograph at night of {vehicle} alone on an empty highway interchange, its body nearly invisible against the dark asphalt, only the cyan-green segment lines and the headlamp beams drawing its shape, faint lane markings, a geometric composition.

shots.title: The command cabin
shots.camera: Interior wide, 18mm, from behind the seats
shots.prompt: Interior photograph of the command cabin of a fictional armoured vehicle from the year 2100: two sculpted front seats with backrests made of segmented black panels like a scorpion's back, a wraparound curved display across the armoured glass slit showing abstract cyan-green terrain lines and a radar ring, an operator station behind with a tilted tactical screen of abstract shapes, an overhead console of tactile switches, dark carbon, black leather and anodised gunmetal, soft cyan ambient light. No readable text, no logos.

shots.title: Interior details
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate interior photographs separated by thin dark gutters, inside the same fictional armoured vehicle from the year 2100, dark carbon, black leather, gunmetal and soft cyan-green light. Top-left: the driver's yoke and a holographic display floating above the dashboard with abstract terrain graphics. Top-right: the segmented black seat backrest with cyan stitching, like a scorpion's back. Bottom-left: the operator station with a curved tactical screen of abstract shapes and a palm-rest controller. Bottom-right: the overhead console of guarded tactile switches lit from below. No readable text, no logos.

shots.title: Technology
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate detail photographs separated by thin dark gutters, close-ups of {vehicle}. Top-left: the sensor pod at the tip of the arched mast, a cluster of lenses glowing cyan. Top-right: a flush armoured hatch on the roof half open, a small black quadcopter drone rising from its bay. Bottom-left: the forward sensor pod with a ring of small camera lenses. Bottom-right: a row of flush countermeasure ports along the armour, closed. Black void background.

shots.title: Materials
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate macro material photographs separated by thin dark gutters, one consistent raking light on black. Top-left: an ultra-matte light-absorbing black coating with a micro texture that swallows light. Top-right: hexagonal ceramic composite armour tiles. Bottom-left: a titanium honeycomb core cut in section. Bottom-right: an airless tyre's honeycomb structure in black rubber.

shots.title: The hangar
shots.prompt: Cinematic photograph of {vehicle} in a vast underground concrete hangar lit by rows of cold linear lights, three engineers in dark technical clothing working around it with tablets, each clearly different in age, build and hair, faces turned away from the camera, a sense of a serious defence-technology company.

shots.title: The inspiration
shots.prompt: Macro photograph at night of a desert scorpion on dark sand glowing cyan-green under ultraviolet light, the segments of its tail and claws outlined in light, everything else black, sharp detail, scientific and beautiful.
